_comment: The look of the display panels (display_core::Theme). Colours, fonts and sizes from the initiator's Claude Design system 'EXO-1 Ship Displays' (2026-10-13): green-black glass, phosphor text, one sky-blue accent, status teal/amber/red-pink always with a glyph. Fonts: Chakra Petch and Share Tech Mono (SIL OFL, files and licences in content/fonts/). screen_idle and bezel are the screen in the world when it shows nothing and its frame (not in the system). The tiers (S 320x240, M 640x400, L 1280x720 panel pixels) are the canvas the panel is drawn on. world: screens nearer than range_m draw their panel live (the screen in use every frame, the others at most once per redraw_s), texture_scale texture pixels per panel pixel. Dev builds reload this file while running.
